title: Hearty Irish Lamb Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew featuring tender lamb, earthy speculaas spice mix, and a boost of render-fat, all while being low in carbs, making it a crowd-pleaser for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the rendered fat over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the speculaas spice mix, chopped carrots, and chopped celery, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
